name: com.huntpdf/pdf-tools
title: HuntPDF - PDF Tools
description: Merge, split, compress, rotate, protect and convert PDFs (Word, Excel, JPG) with HuntPDF.

tools.name: merge_pdf
tools.description: Combine 2-20 PDF files into one PDF, in the order given. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

files.description: The files, each with file_url or file_base64

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF into separate files. Without page_ranges every page becomes its own PDF (returned as a ZIP). With page_ranges like "1-3,4-6" each range becomes one PDF. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

page_ranges.description: Ranges to split into, e.g. "1-3,4-6,7". 1-based page numbers.

tools.name: compress_pdf
tools.description: Reduce PDF file size. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

level.description: low = smallest file (72 dpi), medium = balanced (150 dpi), high = best quality (300 dpi)

tools.name: rotate_pdf
tools.description: Rotate every page of a PDF clockwise. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

tools.name: watermark_pdf
tools.description: Stamp a diagonal text watermark on every page of a PDF. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

tools.name: extract_pdf_pages
tools.description: Make a new PDF that contains only the chosen pages. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

tools.name: add_page_numbers
tools.description: Add page numbers to every page of a PDF. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

format.description: n = "1", n-of-m = "1 of 9", page-n = "Page 1", page-n-of-m = "Page 1 of 9"

tools.name: protect_pdf
tools.description: Encrypt a PDF with a password (AES-256). The password is used once and never stored. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

password.description: Password needed to open the PDF

tools.name: unlock_pdf
tools.description: Remove the password/restrictions from a PDF the user owns. If it needs a password to open, the user must supply it. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

password.description: Current password, if the PDF needs one to open

tools.name: pdf_to_word
tools.description: Convert a PDF into an editable Word (.docx) document. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

tools.name: pdf_to_excel
tools.description: Extract the tables in a PDF into an Excel (.xlsx) workbook. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

tools.name: pdf_to_jpg
tools.description: Convert each PDF page to a JPG image (several pages are returned as a ZIP). Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

tools.name: word_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert a Word document (.docx, .doc, .rtf) to PDF. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

tools.name: jpg_to_pdf
tools.description: Turn 1-20 JPG or PNG images into one PDF, one image per page, in the order given. Files are processed on HuntPDF servers and deleted automatically; the download link is temporary.

file_url.description: Public https:// link to the file (preferred, up to 150 MB). Must be directly downloadable.

file_base64.description: The file content as base64 (only for small files, max 10 MB). Use instead of file_url.

files.description: The files, each with file_url or file_base64
